qualifications: ADAS and JBL branded speakers/subwoofer: Fearless+ PS DCA only; do not extend to diesel/CNG.
Boot volume: petrol/diesel 382 L versus CNG 321 L, measured under ISO V215.
Bharat NCAP footnote applies to petrol/diesel trims active in May 2026; do not extend this claim to CNG.
iRA first-year subscription is free; renewal charges apply.
Fuel/transmission availability varies by trim; use the page 40 matrix.
Warranty headline is 3 years / 100,000 km; full contractual exclusions have not been independently reviewed.
Turbo Boosterjet 6MT, K15C 6MT/6AT and S-CNG 6MT differ in engines and available trims.
Ventilated front seats and 360-view camera are ZXi+ features in the reviewed matrix.
Blind-spot warning, safe-exit alert and rear-cross-traffic alert are qualified by the ZXi Turbo/ZXi+ matrix cells.
Certified fuel-economy figures need engine/transmission/test-cycle qualifiers.
SmartSense/Smart Cruise Control is listed for HX10 and HX10 Knight; not all HX variants.
Front ventilated seats are listed for HX8/HX8 Knight/HX10/HX10 Knight.
12.3-inch ccNC navigation and full digital cluster are HX10/HX10 Knight features.
Engine availability: 1.2 MPi petrol 5MT; 1.0 turbo petrol 6MT/7DCT; 1.5 diesel 6MT/6AT, subject to the original trim plan.
Do not infer steering leather availability from the three omitted HTML rows.

coverage_gaps: No current Tata model/price page content from this fetch: HTTP403 was respected. No city/variant-specific on-road quote, finance offer, EMI, dealer stock or delivery promise is supported.
No verified real-world fuel economy or like-for-like cross-brand safety-rating equivalence.
Images are manufacturer promotional depictions with trim-dependent equipment; Grassland Beige original exterior assets are 750×500 and cabin/detail originals are 614×400.
Only a near-side slight-front view is selected, not a perfectly orthographic side elevation.
Higher-resolution CAMO banner is available but unselected because it depicts a limited edition and contains baked-in text.
Venue flattened brochure tables are unsuitable for automatic per-trim tick alignment; three malformed HTML Leather Pack rows are omitted.
No official direct product video was verified for permitted download.
Permission is based on user confirmation relayed by the parent task; no license document was independently inspected.
recommendation: Use the eight selected unchanged originals, current Nexon brochure, and rival sources with competitor roles. Keep the transparent beige hero; reserve the CAMO banner for an explicitly CAMO-specific demo.
